issues.reason: "Inflection only - never derivation": a noun derived from a verb is a different word and keeps its own form, so the event-noun witness must be typed with its own nominal lemma (as "the ceremony" is typed ceremony), and (Member sk_persist_1 persist) types the entity under a verb class the text never uses.

defect_summary: The compliant form types the event-noun witness with its own nominal lemma - (Member sk_persistence_1 persistence) - carrying the same Experiencer subject and the same During link from the draining event.
notes: The rest is per doctrine: an indefinite-singular subject with a verbal predicate stays a witness (no generic rule), the habitual carries no tense atom, drain takes Patient as a consuming verb, and the "its" genitive gives the event noun its underlying subject role. Routing "many lanterns" to a group plus CardinalityPhrase is licensed - the phrase counts things in object position rather than setting a generic proportion - even though "many" is not itself in the enumerated vague-quantity list.
